# Space Collector

Pilot a ship on an HTML canvas, collect drifting ore while dodging randomly appearing asteroids. Each collision with an asteroid triggers a lose condition. Survive as long as possible and maximize your score.

1: // Space Collector game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // starfield background
8:   const stars = [];
9:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
10:     stars.push({
11:       x: Math.random() * width,
12:       y: Math.random() * height,
13:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5
14:     });
15:   }
16:   // sounds
17:   const collectSound = new Audio('assets/jump.wav');
18:   const crashSound = new Audio('assets/jump.wav');
19:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
20:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
21: 
22:   // Player ship
23:   const ship = {
24:   angle: 0, // radians
25:     x: width / 2,
26:     y: height - 40,
27:     w: 30,
28:     h: 30,
29:     speed: 5,
30:     dx: 0,
31:     dy: 0,
32:     draw() {
33:       // draw ship as a rotated triangle
34:       ctx.save();
35:       ctx.translate(this.x, this.y);
36:       ctx.rotate(this.angle);
37:       ctx.fillStyle = '#0ff';
38:       ctx.beginPath();
39:       ctx.moveTo(0, -this.h / 2);
40:       ctx.lineTo(this.w / 2, this.h / 2);
41:       ctx.lineTo(-this.w / 2, this.h / 2);
42:       ctx.closePath();
43:       ctx.fill();
44:       ctx.restore();
45:     },
46:     update() {
47:       this.x = Math.max(this.w / 2, Math.min(width - this.w / 2, this.x + this.dx));
48:       this.y = Math.max(this.h / 2, Math.min(height - this.h / 2, this.y + this.dy));
49:     }
50:   };
51: 
52:   // Input handling
53:   const keys = {};
54:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.key] = true; });
55:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.key] = false; });
56: 
57:   const ores = [];
58:   const asteroids = [];
59:   let score = 0;
60:   let gameOver = false;
61: 
62:   function spawnOre() {
63:     ores.push({
64:       x: Math.random() * width,
65:       y: -20,
66:       r: 10,
67:       speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2
68:     });
69:   }
70:   function spawnAsteroid() {
71:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
72:     asteroids.push({
73:       x: Math.random() * width,
74:       y: -size,
75:       r: size / 2,
76:       speed: 1 + Math.random() * 2
77:     });
78:   }
79: 
80:   function updateEntities() {
81:     ores.forEach(o => { o.y += o.speed; });
82:     asteroids.forEach(a => { a.y += a.speed; });
83:     // move stars for subtle twinkle effect
84:     stars.forEach(s => {
85:       s.y += 0.3;
86:       s.x += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.2;
87:       if (s.y > height) s.y = 0;
88:       if (s.x < 0) s.x = width;
89:       if (s.x > width) s.x = 0;
90:     });
91:     // Remove off‑screen
92:     while (ores.length && ores[0].y - ores[0].r > height) ores.shift();
93:     while (asteroids.length && asteroids[0].y - asteroids[0].r > height) asteroids.shift();
94:   }
95: 
96:   function checkCollisions() {
97:     // ship vs ore
98:     ores.forEach((o, i) => {
99:       const dx = o.x - ship.x;
100:       const dy = o.y - ship.y;
101:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
102: if (dist < o.r + Math.max(ship.w, ship.h) / 2) {
103:           score++;
104:           collectSound.currentTime = 0;
105:           collectSound.play();
106:           ores.splice(i, 1);
107:         }
108:     });
109:     // ship vs asteroid
110:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
111:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
112:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
113:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
114:       if (dist < a.r + Math.max(ship.w, ship.h) / 2) {
115:           gameOver = true;
116:           crashSound.currentTime = 0;
117:           crashSound.play();
118:         }
119:     });
120:   }
121: 
122:   function draw() {
123:     // background gradient
124:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
125:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#001');
126:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#000');
127:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
128:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
129:     // draw ship
130:     ship.draw();
131: // draw stars (background)
132:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
133:       stars.forEach(s => {
134:         ctx.beginPath();
135:         ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
136:         ctx.fill();
137:       });
138:       // draw ores with gradient
139:       ores.forEach(o => {
140:         const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(o.x, o.y, 0, o.x, o.y, o.r);
141:         grad.addColorStop(0, '#fff700');
142:         grad.addColorStop(1, '#ff0');
143:         ctx.fillStyle = grad;
144:         ctx.beginPath();
145:         ctx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
146:         ctx.fill();
147:       });
148: // draw asteroids with shading
149:       asteroids.forEach(a => {
150:         const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.r * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.r);
151:         grad.addColorStop(0, '#fff');
152:         grad.addColorStop(0.5, '#f44');
153:         grad.addColorStop(1, '#800');
154:         ctx.fillStyle = grad;
155:         ctx.beginPath();
156:         ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
157:         ctx.fill();
158:       });
159:     // score
160:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
161:     ctx.font = '20px sans-serif';
162:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 30);
163:     if (gameOver) {
164:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
165:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
166:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
167:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
168:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
169:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
170:     }
171:   }
172: 
173:   let oreTimer = 0, asteroidTimer = 0;
174:   function loop(timestamp) {
175:     if (gameOver) { draw(); return; }
176:     // input
177:     ship.dx = 0; ship.dy = 0;
178:     if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['a']) ship.dx = -ship.speed;
179:     if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['d']) ship.dx = ship.speed;
180:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['w']) ship.dy = -ship.speed;
181:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['s']) ship.dy = ship.speed;
182:     ship.update();
183:     // spawn
184:     if (oreTimer > 80) { spawnOre(); oreTimer = 0; }
185:     if (asteroidTimer > 200) { spawnAsteroid(); asteroidTimer = 0; }
186:     oreTimer++; asteroidTimer++;
187:     // update & collisions
188:     updateEntities();
189:     checkCollisions();
190:     draw();
191:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
192:   }
193:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
194: })();
